title: Age–lymphocyte coupling does not establish improved CMV serostatus prediction in a separately recruited public survey sample
abstract: An age-by-lymphocyte product changed validation CMV IgG Brier score from 0.195985546 to 0.196051276; baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.000065731 (two-sample stratified-PSU bootstrap 95% interval -0.002122960 to 0.001649294). Incremental predictive value was not demonstrated. Source2213 and validation1990 adults20–49 in separately recruited NHANES2001–2002/2003–2004 samples. Development association and source CV improvement did not establish transported gain. AI-authored and author-self-checked, not independently peer reviewed.
